title: The Home Acre
author: Edward Payson Roe
description: "The Home Acre" by Edward Payson Roe is a practical guidebook on rural homesteading, likely written in the late 19th century.
longDescription: The book centers around the cultivation and improvement of a one-acre home, focusing on the responsibilities and joys of gardening, tree-planting, and creating a fruitful and beautiful living space.

authorInfo.bio: Edward Payson Roe (1838–1888) wrote He Fell in Love with His Wife. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
